_comment: ROOT CONFIG INDEX. Read this first. app/config = Git schemas; data/lake = Parquet instances. See coverage.json for full audit.
description: OpenEstates application config root. Git is source of truth. No entity instances, no Parquet, no society/road names.

dag.purpose: Control plane: ontology, leaves, asset graph, enrichment, UI surfaces, crawl policies

bootstrap.purpose: How importers infer nodes/edges. Output goes to lake only.

lake.purpose: Parquet zone layout and S3/local sync contract

runtime.purpose: Environment variable names and local-only path defaults

product.purpose: Landing copy and curated shelves; evidence section ownership moved to app/config/dag/evidence_sections.json

coverage.purpose: Audit: what is in config vs lake vs still hardcoded in Rust

separation.app_config: Schemas, policies, registries — versioned in Git
separation.data_lake: Enriched entities, facts, edges, serving bundles — Parquet in data/lake or S3
separation.data_cache: Rebuildable local caches — never synced, never source of truth
separation.data_validation: Eval baselines and QA reports — optional, not runtime input
